content: Dig within. Within is the well of good, and it will ever bubble forth, if you will ever dig.
author: Marcus Aurelius
story:
There is a sharp, grounded clarity in this observation. True wisdom is rarely complicated or flashy, but it demands the honesty to look at our own habits and assumptions without defensive excuses.

Marcus Aurelius understood that real peace is never won by escaping the world or blaming external circumstances. When you stop looking for external validation and anchor your self-worth in quiet integrity, the noisy chaos of the world loses its power over you. A good life is built day by day through small, conscious choices.
reflectionPrompt: In what relationship or encounter can you practice seeing beyond outer masks into shared humanity?
